Frozen sample reports tax-buffer, sales-contraction, and profit cash-driver persistence as strengthened; enterprise inventory accumulation and payable-only buffer as weakened. Annual versus H1 amounts are not directly subtracted. This review checked identity and rule linkage; it did not redo prior C3 source extraction/calculation validation.

actionable_findings.title: Displayed cash weakening condition and evaluator disagree
actionable_findings.evidence: For old={cash_driver:working_capital, ocf_change:1000000000}, new={cash_driver:working_capital, ocf_change:-1000000000}, mechanism_criteria.weaken_single includes 'or delta OCF turns from positive to negative', but continuation._decide(..., same_kind=True) returns strengthened because the driver identity remains working_capital.
actionable_findings.impact: A research user can see a weakening threshold satisfied while the machine calls the same hypothesis strengthened. Current Yanghe frozen sample is unaffected because its old delta OCF is already negative.
actionable_findings.recommended_minimum: Keep this cash card about driver identity alone and remove the extra unevaluated delta-OCF sign weakening clause. If a cash-growth-direction hypothesis is later valuable, give it its own explicit research identity; do not overload this card or build a new general rules framework. Add only the reproduced seam check.

actionable_findings.title: Old snapshot means reconstructed material snapshot, not a selected prior frozen hypothesis
actionable_findings.evidence: Ordinary API accepts old_material_id/new_material_id only. _mechanism_block calls _snap_of(old_doc) and recomputes old judgments with current code. No old_snapshot_id input is consumed and no previously saved old hypothesis/criterion state is loaded. The result stores a snapshot hash but not the full original baseline snapshot. UI 'old mechanism snapshot' currently selects a material ID.
actionable_findings.impact: The sample is a reproducible historical-material replay with current algorithms. It is not yet a user-preserved original-hypothesis update. A later algorithm change can reconstruct different old judgments from the same old material.
actionable_findings.recommended_minimum: Label the current action as historical material replay. For the next user capability, reuse the existing content-addressed experiment file to freeze a small baseline readings + hypothesis + criteria + source identity object, accept its explicit baseline ID, then compare new disclosure to that immutable baseline without recomputing the old judgment. No new database, worker, service, or DSL.

Prefer 'this window no longer accumulates; confirmation pending' as part of the same concise user-capability pass. Do not turn this into a standalone broad wording campaign.
